summary: Both warbands race for a toppled wagon rumoured to carry a noble's strongbox. The Wolves seize the prize — 30 gold crowns and a very surprised chicken — but the bridge takes its toll on both sides.

report.outcome: The Wolves won the contest for the noble's strongbox and carried off its 30 crowns and a chicken. Boris sent Pavel along the riverbed while the vanguards fought on the span. Recovering the prize explains the recorded victory, but the original rulebook scenario and formal win condition are not specified.
report.prologue: A toppled wagon lies at the Broken Bridge, rumoured to hold a noble's strongbox. Both companies are converging on the crossing. The prize is within reach, but the damaged span offers little room to fight and no assurance that it will bear the struggle.
battle: The fight gathered around the wagon and the narrow bridge. The dwarf vanguard held against two Ostlander rushes; Dmitri's own account credits him with reaching the wagon first and holding the span until his kin arrived. Both records describe a hard contest for the same cramped ground.

Dagna charged along the broken span under arrow-fire and scattered the line at the wagon. Across the river, Borri splintered the wheel sheltering Anya. Her arrows nevertheless drove the dwarf vanguard back. Okri's final shot knocked an unnamed Ostlander off the wagon; an arrow then caught him as he reloaded. Anya's tally records his name.

Boris turned the fight on the bridge into a distraction, sending Pavel down the riverbed. Yuri hacked through the wagon axle to stop the dwarfs dragging it away. Snorri reached for the strongbox and caught the chicken instead, while Mikhail picked the lock as the prize was being carried.

When the bridge gave way beneath Dmitri, Yuri dived after him and surfaced with only the strongbox. Pavel carried the box and chicken along the riverbed, but was too far downstream to help. Thorgrim anchored the dwarf rearguard on the last standing arch, and Grimnir brought Okri's body back so no dwarf was left in the river.
report.epilogue: The Wolves secure their first recorded victory and the strongbox. Both companies leave a place empty in their ranks: Okri falls to an arrow, and Dmitri is lost with the bridge.

perspectives.prologue: A noble's strongbox belongs in a sound vault, not in a wagon over a rotten river. Get the vanguard to the prize, hold the crossing, and keep the Wolves back. The bridge is narrow enough that steady feet should count for more than their haste.
perspectives.epilogue: The Ostlanders have the box. We have brought every surviving dwarf home, and Grimnir has brought Okri with them. Borri has lost the companion of twenty years of powder-smoke. Thorgrim's account of what the Wolves owe us has grown by half a page.
perspectives.accomplishments: Held the wagon against two rushes, secured the survivors' withdrawal, and recovered Okri's body from the broken crossing.

perspectives.prologue: Thirty crowns, if the rumour is true, would bring the old lands a little nearer. Let the dwarfs watch the span; Boris sees another approach through the riverbed. Anya must keep their heads down long enough for the clan to reach the wagon.
perspectives.epilogue: At last we have won, and the box holds the promised crowns. The chicken is ours too. But Yuri could not bring Dmitri back, and Boris must bury a grandson on the evening of his first victory. Anya cuts Okri's notch without pride.
perspectives.accomplishments: Outflanked the bridge defenders, secured the noble's strongbox and its 30 crowns, and brought home the clan's new chicken mascot.

loot: The Wolves secured the noble's strongbox containing 30 gold crowns.
A chicken recovered with the prize has been adopted as the Wolves' clan mascot.
campaignNotes: Anya's arrow killed Okri Stonebrow; Grimnir recovered his body.
Dmitri Wolfenstein was lost when the bridge collapsed. No opposing warrior is credited with this environmental casualty.
Ludmilla's crows warned the clan away from an ambush on the north bank.
The records disagree about who reached the wagon first; both accounts are preserved rather than choosing one.
Okri knocked an unnamed Ostlander from the wagon. Neither that warrior's identity nor an out-of-action result is recorded.

outOfAction.detail: Killed by an arrow while reloading at the Broken Bridge; Anya's battle tally identifies Okri.

warbands.name: Grimhammer's Oathbound
highlights: The vanguard reached the wagon first and held it against the first two Ostlander rushes.
lowlights: Okri Stonebrow fell to an Ostlander arrow as he calmly reloaded, humming a song only he could hear.

members.name: Thorgrim Grimhammer
members.highlight: Anchored the rearguard on the bridge's last standing arch so every surviving dwarf came home.
members.lowlight: Watched the strongbox — and the ledger's due — carried off by Ostlanders. The grudge entry filled half a page.

members.name: Borri Forkbeard
members.highlight: Splintered the wagon wheel Anya was using for cover with a single shot from across the river.
members.lowlight: Stood beside Okri for twenty years of powder-smoke, and now stands beside his grave.

members.name: Dagna Ironmaid
members.highlight: Charged the length of the broken span under arrow-fire, scattering the Ostlander line at the wagon.
members.lowlight: The bridge collapsed behind her instead of under her. Denied again.

members.name: Snorri Halfpint
members.highlight: The span he was standing on was the only part of the bridge that did not move all day.
members.lowlight: Reached out for the strongbox and caught the chicken instead.

members.name: Grimnir Coalfist
members.highlight: Carried Okri's body back across the ruined span so no dwarf was left in the river.
members.lowlight: Took an arrow through the cloak a hand's breadth from the heart.

members.name: Okri Stonebrow
members.highlight: His last shot knocked an Ostlander kinsman off the wagon and bought the vanguard time to regroup.
members.lowlight: An Ostlander arrow found him at the Broken Bridge as he calmly reloaded. He never heard the shot that took him.

warbands.name: Wolfenstein's Wolves
highlights: Seized the noble's strongbox — 30 gold crowns — and a very surprised chicken, since adopted as the clan mascot.
lowlights: Dmitri Wolfenstein was lost when the Broken Bridge gave way beneath him. The strongbox, the clan notes bitterly, floated.

members.name: Boris Wolfenstein
members.highlight: Out-thought the dwarfs at last: sent Pavel down the riverbed while the vanguards brawled on the span.
members.lowlight: Won the clan's first victory and buried a grandson the same evening.

members.name: Yuri Wolfenstein
members.highlight: Hacked the wagon's axle in two so no dwarf could drag the prize away.
members.lowlight: Dived into the river after Dmitri and came up with only the strongbox.

members.name: Anya Wolfenstein
members.highlight: Her arrows drove back the dwarf vanguard and won the day — five new notches on a bow running out of room.
members.lowlight: One of those five notches was for Okri Stonebrow, and she carved it without pride.

members.name: Ludmilla the Crow-Mother
members.highlight: Her crows led the clan away from a dwarf ambush at the north bank — the second of her three warnings.
members.lowlight: The crows fell silent when Dmitri stepped onto the span, and she understood too late what that meant.

members.name: Pavel the Slow
members.highlight: Waded the riverbed with the strongbox under one arm and the chicken under the other, unhurried as ever.
members.lowlight: Was too far downstream to reach Dmitri when the span gave way.

members.name: Mikhail Halfhand
members.highlight: Picked the strongbox's lock while it was still being carried, to 'check the rumour was worth it.' It was.
members.lowlight: Wagered his share of the 30 crowns on a coin toss with Yuri and lost — to his own loaded coin.

members.name: Dmitri Wolfenstein
members.highlight: First to reach the toppled wagon, he held the span alone against the dwarf vanguard until his kin arrived.
members.lowlight: The Broken Bridge itself gave way beneath him. He survived the wolf winter of '94 and three of Borri's misfires — but not this.
